description: Audit-record footer debt, frozen 2026-10-14 and DRAINED 2026-10-11. Every file under docs/records/audits/ is REQUIRED by check-audit-stamps.py to carry a '> last audited' footer. This list once named the records written before that rule existed; it may only SHRINK, and it is now EMPTY: all 469 records under docs/records/audits/ carry a footer. A new record without one fails immediately and must not be added here -- the point of the rule is to stop the inflow. Drained with .agents/skills/docs-auditor/scripts/apply-record-footers.py: 127 records dated themselves (filename prefix or '**Date:**' header), 133 had no date of their own and took their own last COMMIT date from git rather than the repair's date, so no footer claims an audit that did not happen. Three records needed hand repair for structural defects the drain surfaced: closure-after-await-hunt.md carried a stranded footer mid-file, setup-wizard-audit.md had a nested '> > last audited' mark, and design-exceptions.md had a comment-broken footer block.
